**Media capture, fixed against real sites.**

0.9.0's media capture was tested on a demo site. Re-inspecting a real library of 39 clips (frontier labs, dev tools, docs sites) turned up eight problems. 0.9.2 fixes all of them:

- **Web pages saved as media.** When a video had no source yet, or an icon link was stale, the server answered with its HTML page, and Artspo saved that as `.html` while clip.md pointed at an `.mp4` or `.png` that didn't exist. Those are now refused and listed as not saved.
- **The site's own logo** is recognized wherever it links home, including sticky headers and footers. It used to come out as "illustration".
- **Other companies' marks** are labeled `partner logo` (customers, investors), `social icon` (GitHub, X, Discord…) or `brand icon` (integrations), not `logo`, and stay out of the site's icon-system summary.
- **Colors** in oklch, oklab, lab and `color()` syntax are converted to sRGB everywhere: palette, borders, shadows, buttons and the SVG files themselves.
- **SVGs with their own `<style>` block** kept that block's colors instead of the page's. Paint is now written as inline style, which wins.
- **Hover-only art** (an arrow at opacity 0 until hover) was saved invisible. It's saved visible now, and marked "hidden until hover or scroll".
- **The same video listed several times** is listed once, with how many times it appears.
- **Round vector logos** in a "trusted by" row are no longer called avatars.

### Updating

`git pull`, click ↻ on Artspo in `chrome://extensions`, then **↻ Re-inspect all** in the popup to redo your clips' media.

### Files

- `artspo-0.9.2.zip`: the whole repo (extension, skill, MCP server, docs). Use this one.
- `artspo-extension-0.9.2.zip`: just the `extension/` folder, the Chrome Web Store upload.

Requires Chrome 118+ on macOS (Linux works; Windows isn't supported). [5-minute tutorial](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md) · [artbook.dev](https://artbook.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=artspo)
